note: Shared by the TypeScript normaliser tests (apps/web/src/lib/hr/employee-number.test.ts) and the SQL function tests (packages/rls-tests/test/employee-number.rls.test.ts). Every pair is an input and the one canonical form it must give in BOTH places. Rule: trim, remove all spaces, upper-case; if the number ends in digits, drop their leading zeros and pad back to at least three digits (longer numbers keep every digit); anything without trailing digits is only trimmed and upper-cased. Fictional numbers.
